selected_problem: After the previous cycle made acceptance fail closed above eight validation commands, fresh-main inspection found federation could still rank, count and select a proposal with nine-to-sixteen validation commands as executable. Such a winner was guaranteed to reach acceptance and fail VALIDATION_COMMAND_BUDGET_EXCEEDED only after its changes had already been staged/applied, wasting an avoidable repair cycle and allowing impossible candidates to contribute consensus signals.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: The committed router selects DEEP_DEVELOPMENT through the singular evidence-rich central bottleneck gate; no forced mode rotation was used.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed. Selection/routing use committed DWAC source-contract replay over fresh canonical main while the provider remained transiently unavailable.

pre_fix_reproduction.input: One proposal with nine unique validation commands plus a second proposal within the eight-command acceptance budget.
pre_fix_reproduction.observed: Fresh main treated the nine-command proposal as executable for consensus/validCount and allowed it to be a winner candidate even though acceptance now deterministically rejects it before execution.

changes: Federated proposal normalization preserves up to sixteen validation commands for audit, but now marks validation_overflow when the normalized unique set exceeds the executable acceptance budget of eight.
Overflowing proposals receive a bounded VALIDATION_COMMAND_BUDGET_EXCEEDED risk marker.
Consensus executableCount, validCount and winner selection now use one executableProposal predicate that excludes validation-overflow candidates as well as empty/ambiguous candidates.
A bounded valid proposal can win instead of a higher-ranked candidate that is already known to be impossible to accept.
truth_boundaries: This prevents federation from choosing a proposal already known to exceed the current acceptance command budget; it does not solve evidence selection when more than eight validations are genuinely required.

The executable budget value is currently duplicated between generation and acceptance; a future shared policy contract may reduce drift risk, but introducing that architecture was not necessary to close this concrete false-executability path.
Monorepo and arbitrary multi-language validation discovery remain incomplete.
OS-level filesystem/network sandboxing, Windows descendant-tree equivalence, arbitrary complex semantic synthesis and crash-level filesystem atomicity remain unresolved.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive/irreversible external action was performed.
